```{=html}
<style>
.coupled-pendula-lab {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 292px;
  gap: 10px;
  width: min(1140px, 100%);
  height: 488px;
  margin: 0.05rem auto 0;
  color: #f2f5f8;
  font: 15px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif;
}

.coupled-pendula-lab * { box-sizing: border-box; }

.coupled-pendula-stage,
.coupled-pendula-panel {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 42% 25%, rgba(88, 184, 255, 0.08), transparent 42%),
    rgba(7, 11, 17, 0.96);
}

.coupled-pendula-stage { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.coupled-pendula-svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.coupled-pendula-support { stroke: #c5ced8; stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; }
.coupled-pendula-pivot { fill: #f4f6f8; }
.coupled-pendula-rod { stroke: #cbd4de; stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
.coupled-pendula-bob--one { fill: #58b8ff; stroke: #bce5ff; stroke-width: 3; }
.coupled-pendula-bob--two { fill: #ffc85c; stroke: #ffe3a6; stroke-width: 3; }
.coupled-pendula-spring {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #7ee2ae;
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.coupled-pendula-axis,
.coupled-pendula-grid {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
}

.coupled-pendula-grid {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  stroke-dasharray: 4 5;
}

.coupled-pendula-curve--one,
.coupled-pendula-curve--two { fill: none; stroke-width: 3; }
.coupled-pendula-curve--one { stroke: #58b8ff; }
.coupled-pendula-curve--two { stroke: #ffc85c; }
.coupled-pendula-amplitude-line {
  stroke: #7ee2ae;
  stroke-width: 1.5;
  stroke-dasharray: 5 5;
}
.coupled-pendula-marker { fill: #f7fbff; stroke: #111820; stroke-width: 1.4; }
.coupled-pendula-text { fill: #eef3f8; font: 16px system-ui, sans-serif; }
.coupled-pendula-text--small { fill: #aeb9c7; font: 13px system-ui, sans-serif; }
.coupled-pendula-text--one { fill: #58b8ff; font-weight: 750; }
.coupled-pendula-text--two { fill: #ffc85c; font-weight: 750; }

.coupled-pendula-panel {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.coupled-pendula-source {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 6px;
}

.coupled-pendula-source button,
.coupled-pendula-actions button {
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(124, 199, 255, 0.46);
  border-radius: 7px;
  color: #eaf6ff;
  background: rgba(88, 184, 255, 0.09);
  font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.coupled-pendula-source button[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: #7cc7ff;
  color: #07111a;
  background: #7cc7ff;
}

.coupled-pendula-control {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: 0 8px;
  align-items: center;
}

.coupled-pendula-control label { color: #dce5ee; font-size: 12px; }
.coupled-pendula-control output {
  min-width: 58px;
  color: #fff;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: right;
}

.coupled-pendula-control input[type="range"] {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  width: 100%;
  height: 12px;
  margin: 0;
  accent-color: #7cc7ff;
}

.coupled-pendula-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 2px 8px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.coupled-pendula-summary span:nth-child(even) { color: #fff; text-align: right; }

.coupled-pendula-probability {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr 43px;
  gap: 5px;
  align-items: center;
}
.coupled-pendula-probability strong { font-size: 13px; }
.coupled-pendula-probability output {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: right;
}
.coupled-pendula-track {
  height: 11px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}
.coupled-pendula-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; }
.coupled-pendula-fill--one { background: #58b8ff; }
.coupled-pendula-fill--two { background: #ffc85c; }
.coupled-pendula-actions {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: auto;
}
.coupled-pendula-exact {
  margin: 0;
  color: #7ee2ae;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-align: center;
}

.reveal .derivation-main-with-note { width: 73%; }
.reveal .slides section.pendulum-tight { font-size: 0.84em; }
.reveal .slides section.pendulum-tight > h2 { font-size: calc(1.6em / 0.84); }
</style>

<div class="coupled-pendula-lab" data-coupled-pendula-lab>
  <div class="coupled-pendula-stage">
    <svg class="coupled-pendula-svg" viewBox="0 0 820 488"
         role="img" aria-label="Интерактивная модель двух связанных маятников разных масс">
      <line class="coupled-pendula-support" x1="75" y1="38" x2="565" y2="38"></line>
      <circle class="coupled-pendula-pivot" cx="220" cy="49" r="6"></circle>
      <circle class="coupled-pendula-pivot" cx="425" cy="49" r="6"></circle>
      <line class="coupled-pendula-rod" data-rod-one x1="220" y1="49" x2="220" y2="250"></line>
      <line class="coupled-pendula-rod" data-rod-two x1="425" y1="49" x2="425" y2="250"></line>
      <path class="coupled-pendula-spring" data-spring></path>
      <circle class="coupled-pendula-bob--one" data-bob-one cx="220" cy="250" r="25"></circle>
      <circle class="coupled-pendula-bob--two" data-bob-two cx="425" cy="250" r="25"></circle>

      <text class="coupled-pendula-text coupled-pendula-text--one"
            x="220" y="298" text-anchor="middle" data-label-one>1: m₁</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text coupled-pendula-text--two"
            x="425" y="298" text-anchor="middle" data-label-two>2: m₂</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="650" y="82" text-anchor="middle">
        точная двухуровневая амплитуда
      </text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text" x="650" y="112" text-anchor="middle" data-state-readout>
        старт: маятник 1
      </text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="650" y="148" text-anchor="middle">
        xᵢ = √mᵢ φᵢ
      </text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text" x="650" y="180" text-anchor="middle" data-angle-readout>
        θ = 45.0°
      </text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text" x="650" y="210" text-anchor="middle" data-amplitude-readout>
        sin²2θ = 1.000
      </text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="650" y="248" text-anchor="middle">
        реальное движение = Re aᵢ/√mᵢ
      </text>

      <line class="coupled-pendula-axis" x1="66" y1="446" x2="774" y2="446"></line>
      <line class="coupled-pendula-axis" x1="66" y1="326" x2="66" y2="446"></line>
      <line class="coupled-pendula-grid" x1="66" y1="326" x2="774" y2="326"></line>
      <line class="coupled-pendula-grid" x1="66" y1="386" x2="774" y2="386"></line>
      <line class="coupled-pendula-amplitude-line" data-amplitude-line x1="66" y1="326" x2="774" y2="326"></line>
      <path class="coupled-pendula-curve--one" data-curve-one></path>
      <path class="coupled-pendula-curve--two" data-curve-two></path>
      <circle class="coupled-pendula-marker" data-marker-one cx="66" cy="326" r="5"></circle>
      <circle class="coupled-pendula-marker" data-marker-two cx="66" cy="446" r="5"></circle>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="55" y="331" text-anchor="end">1</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="55" y="451" text-anchor="end">0</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small coupled-pendula-text--one" x="82" y="343">P₁</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small coupled-pendula-text--two" x="82" y="365">P₂</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="66" y="472" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="420" y="472" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="774" y="472" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
      <text class="coupled-pendula-text--small" x="420" y="484" text-anchor="middle">Δωt / π</text>
    </svg>
  </div>

  <div class="coupled-pendula-panel">
    <div class="coupled-pendula-source" role="group" aria-label="Стартовый маятник">
      <button type="button" data-source="1" aria-pressed="true">Старт: 1</button>
      <button type="button" data-source="2" aria-pressed="false">Старт: 2</button>
    </div>

    <div class="coupled-pendula-control">
      <label for="coupled-mass-ratio">отношение m₂/m₁</label>
      <output data-mass-output>1.00</output>
      <input id="coupled-mass-ratio" data-mass type="range"
             min="-1" max="1" step="0.005" value="0">
    </div>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-control">
      <label for="coupled-coupling">связь k/(m₁ω₀²)</label>
      <output data-coupling-output>0.15</output>
      <input id="coupled-coupling" data-coupling type="range"
             min="0.03" max="0.60" step="0.005" value="0.15">
    </div>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-control">
      <label for="coupled-amplitude">начальный угол</label>
      <output data-initial-output>14°</output>
      <input id="coupled-amplitude" data-initial type="range"
             min="3" max="22" step="1" value="14">
    </div>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-control">
      <label for="coupled-carrier-phase">фаза носителя</label>
      <output data-carrier-output>0°</output>
      <input id="coupled-carrier-phase" data-carrier type="range"
             min="0" max="355" step="5" value="0">
    </div>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-control">
      <label for="coupled-speed">скорость</label>
      <output data-speed-output>×1.0</output>
      <input id="coupled-speed" data-speed type="range"
             min="0.2" max="2.0" step="0.1" value="1">
    </div>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-control">
      <label for="coupled-phase">фаза Δωt/π</label>
      <output data-phase-output>0.00</output>
      <input id="coupled-phase" data-phase type="range"
             min="0" max="2" step="0.002" value="0">
    </div>

    <div class="coupled-pendula-summary">
      <span>θ</span><span data-theta>45.0°</span>
      <span>ω₊ / ω₀</span><span data-omega-plus>1.000</span>
      <span>ω₋ / ω₀</span><span data-omega-minus>1.140</span>
      <span>Pmax</span><span data-pmax>1.000</span>
    </div>

    <div class="coupled-pendula-probability">
      <strong style="color:#58b8ff">P₁</strong>
      <div class="coupled-pendula-track"><div class="coupled-pendula-fill coupled-pendula-fill--one" data-fill-one></div></div>
      <output data-prob-one>1.000</output>
    </div>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-probability">
      <strong style="color:#ffc85c">P₂</strong>
      <div class="coupled-pendula-track"><div class="coupled-pendula-fill coupled-pendula-fill--two" data-fill-two></div></div>
      <output data-prob-two>0.000</output>
    </div>

    <p class="coupled-pendula-exact">P₁ + P₂ = 1 точно, без усреднения</p>
    <div class="coupled-pendula-actions">
      <button type="button" data-toggle>Пауза</button>
      <button type="button" data-reset>Сначала</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const OMEGA_ZERO = 2.6;
  const PIVOT_Y = 49;
  const LENGTH = 201;
  const PIVOT_ONE = 220;
  const PIVOT_TWO = 425;
  const PLOT_LEFT = 66;
  const PLOT_RIGHT = 774;
  const PLOT_TOP = 326;
  const PLOT_BOTTOM = 446;

  const complex = (re, im) => ({re, im});
  const add = (left, right) =>
    complex(left.re + right.re, left.im + right.im);
  const subtract = (left, right) =>
    complex(left.re - right.re, left.im - right.im);
  const scale = (value, factor) =>
    complex(value.re * factor, value.im * factor);
  const phase = angle => complex(Math.cos(angle), -Math.sin(angle));
  const modulusSquared = value =>
    value.re * value.re + value.im * value.im;

  function bobPosition(pivotX, angle) {
    return {
      x: pivotX + LENGTH * Math.sin(angle),
      y: PIVOT_Y + LENGTH * Math.cos(angle)
    };
  }

  function springPath(start, end) {
    const dx = end.x - start.x;
    const dy = end.y - start.y;
    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const nx = -dy / distance;
    const ny = dx / distance;
    const points = [
      "M" + start.x.toFixed(2) + "," + start.y.toFixed(2)
    ];
    const turns = 14;

    for (let index = 1; index < turns; index += 1) {
      const fraction = index / turns;
      const envelope = Math.sin(Math.PI * fraction);
      const offset = (index % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 6 * envelope;
      const x = start.x + fraction * dx + offset * nx;
      const y = start.y + fraction * dy + offset * ny;
      points.push("L" + x.toFixed(2) + "," + y.toFixed(2));
    }
    points.push("L" + end.x.toFixed(2) + "," + end.y.toFixed(2));
    return points.join(" ");
  }

  function probabilityAt(source, mixingAmplitude, phaseDifference) {
    const transition =
      mixingAmplitude * Math.sin(phaseDifference / 2) ** 2;
    return source === 1
      ? {one: 1 - transition, two: transition}
      : {one: transition, two: 1 - transition};
  }

  function curvePath(source, mixingAmplitude, which) {
    const points = [];
    const samples = 180;
    for (let index = 0; index <= samples; index += 1) {
      const fraction = index / samples;
      const difference = 2 * Math.PI * fraction;
      const probabilities =
        probabilityAt(source, mixingAmplitude, difference);
      const value = which === 1 ? probabilities.one : probabilities.two;
      const x = PLOT_LEFT + fraction * (PLOT_RIGHT - PLOT_LEFT);
      const y = PLOT_BOTTOM - value * (PLOT_BOTTOM - PLOT_TOP);
      points.push(
        (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") +
        x.toFixed(2) + "," + y.toFixed(2)
      );
    }
    return points.join(" ");
  }

  function initialize(root) {
    if (root.dataset.coupledPendulaReady === "true") return;
    root.dataset.coupledPendulaReady = "true";

    const get = selector => root.querySelector(selector);
    const sourceButtons = [...root.querySelectorAll("[data-source]")];
    const massInput = get("[data-mass]");
    const couplingInput = get("[data-coupling]");
    const initialInput = get("[data-initial]");
    const carrierInput = get("[data-carrier]");
    const speedInput = get("[data-speed]");
    const phaseInput = get("[data-phase]");
    const toggle = get("[data-toggle]");
    const reset = get("[data-reset]");
    const rodOne = get("[data-rod-one]");
    const rodTwo = get("[data-rod-two]");
    const bobOne = get("[data-bob-one]");
    const bobTwo = get("[data-bob-two]");
    const spring = get("[data-spring]");
    const curveOne = get("[data-curve-one]");
    const curveTwo = get("[data-curve-two]");
    const markerOne = get("[data-marker-one]");
    const markerTwo = get("[data-marker-two]");
    const amplitudeLine = get("[data-amplitude-line]");

    let source = 1;
    let running = true;
    let beatPhase = 0;
    let lastFrame = performance.now();

    function parameters() {
      const ratio = 10 ** Number(massInput.value);
      const coupling = Number(couplingInput.value);
      const thetaZero = Number(initialInput.value) * Math.PI / 180;
      const carrierPhase = Number(carrierInput.value) * Math.PI / 180;
      const speed = Number(speedInput.value);
      const massOne = 1;
      const massTwo = ratio;
      const totalMass = massOne + massTwo;
      const cosine = Math.sqrt(massOne / totalMass);
      const sine = Math.sqrt(massTwo / totalMass);
      const theta = Math.atan2(sine, cosine);
      const mixingAmplitude = 4 * cosine * cosine * sine * sine;
      const springConstant =
        coupling * massOne * OMEGA_ZERO * OMEGA_ZERO;
      const omegaPlus = OMEGA_ZERO;
      const omegaMinus = Math.sqrt(
        OMEGA_ZERO * OMEGA_ZERO +
        springConstant * (1 / massOne + 1 / massTwo)
      );
      return {
        ratio,
        coupling,
        thetaZero,
        carrierPhase,
        speed,
        massOne,
        massTwo,
        cosine,
        sine,
        theta,
        mixingAmplitude,
        omegaPlus,
        omegaMinus,
        deltaOmega: omegaMinus - omegaPlus
      };
    }

    function amplitudes(values) {
      const time =
        values.deltaOmega > 0 ? beatPhase / values.deltaOmega : 0;
      const plus = phase(values.omegaPlus * time);
      const minus = phase(values.omegaMinus * time);
      const sourceMass =
        source === 1 ? values.massOne : values.massTwo;
      const initialScale = Math.sqrt(sourceMass) * values.thetaZero;

      if (source === 1) {
        return {
          one: scale(
            add(
              scale(plus, values.cosine ** 2),
              scale(minus, values.sine ** 2)
            ),
            initialScale
          ),
          two: scale(
            subtract(plus, minus),
            initialScale * values.cosine * values.sine
          )
        };
      }

      return {
        one: scale(
          subtract(plus, minus),
          initialScale * values.cosine * values.sine
        ),
        two: scale(
          add(
            scale(plus, values.sine ** 2),
            scale(minus, values.cosine ** 2)
          ),
          initialScale
        )
      };
    }

    function rotate(value, angle) {
      return complex(
        value.re * Math.cos(angle) - value.im * Math.sin(angle),
        value.re * Math.sin(angle) + value.im * Math.cos(angle)
      );
    }

    function render() {
      const values = parameters();
      const raw = amplitudes(values);
      const one = rotate(raw.one, values.carrierPhase);
      const two = rotate(raw.two, values.carrierPhase);
      const normalization = modulusSquared(one) + modulusSquared(two);
      const probabilityOne = modulusSquared(one) / normalization;
      const probabilityTwo = modulusSquared(two) / normalization;
      const angleOne = one.re / Math.sqrt(values.massOne);
      const angleTwo = two.re / Math.sqrt(values.massTwo);
      const positionOne = bobPosition(PIVOT_ONE, angleOne);
      const positionTwo = bobPosition(PIVOT_TWO, angleTwo);

      rodOne.setAttribute("x2", positionOne.x.toFixed(2));
      rodOne.setAttribute("y2", positionOne.y.toFixed(2));
      rodTwo.setAttribute("x2", positionTwo.x.toFixed(2));
      rodTwo.setAttribute("y2", positionTwo.y.toFixed(2));
      bobOne.setAttribute("cx", positionOne.x.toFixed(2));
      bobOne.setAttribute("cy", positionOne.y.toFixed(2));
      bobTwo.setAttribute("cx", positionTwo.x.toFixed(2));
      bobTwo.setAttribute("cy", positionTwo.y.toFixed(2));
      spring.setAttribute("d", springPath(positionOne, positionTwo));

      const radiusTwo =
        Math.max(17, Math.min(40, 25 * values.ratio ** 0.25));
      bobTwo.setAttribute("r", radiusTwo.toFixed(1));
      get("[data-label-one]").textContent = "1: m₁";
      get("[data-label-two]").textContent =
        "2: " + values.ratio.toFixed(2) + " m₁";
      get("[data-state-readout]").textContent =
        "старт: маятник " + source;
      get("[data-angle-readout]").textContent =
        "θ = " + (values.theta * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1) + "°";
      get("[data-amplitude-readout]").textContent =
        "sin²2θ = " + values.mixingAmplitude.toFixed(3);

      curveOne.setAttribute(
        "d",
        curvePath(source, values.mixingAmplitude, 1)
      );
      curveTwo.setAttribute(
        "d",
        curvePath(source, values.mixingAmplitude, 2)
      );
      const markerX = PLOT_LEFT +
        (beatPhase / (2 * Math.PI)) * (PLOT_RIGHT - PLOT_LEFT);
      markerOne.setAttribute("cx", markerX.toFixed(2));
      markerOne.setAttribute(
        "cy",
        (PLOT_BOTTOM -
          probabilityOne * (PLOT_BOTTOM - PLOT_TOP)).toFixed(2)
      );
      markerTwo.setAttribute("cx", markerX.toFixed(2));
      markerTwo.setAttribute(
        "cy",
        (PLOT_BOTTOM -
          probabilityTwo * (PLOT_BOTTOM - PLOT_TOP)).toFixed(2)
      );
      const amplitudeY = PLOT_BOTTOM -
        values.mixingAmplitude * (PLOT_BOTTOM - PLOT_TOP);
      amplitudeLine.setAttribute("y1", amplitudeY.toFixed(2));
      amplitudeLine.setAttribute("y2", amplitudeY.toFixed(2));

      get("[data-mass-output]").textContent = values.ratio.toFixed(2);
      get("[data-coupling-output]").textContent =
        values.coupling.toFixed(2);
      get("[data-initial-output]").textContent =
        Math.round(values.thetaZero * 180 / Math.PI) + "°";
      get("[data-carrier-output]").textContent =
        Math.round(values.carrierPhase * 180 / Math.PI) + "°";
      get("[data-speed-output]").textContent =
        "×" + values.speed.toFixed(1);
      get("[data-phase-output]").textContent =
        (beatPhase / Math.PI).toFixed(2);
      phaseInput.value = (beatPhase / Math.PI).toFixed(3);
      get("[data-theta]").textContent =
        (values.theta * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1) + "°";
      get("[data-omega-plus]").textContent =
        (values.omegaPlus / OMEGA_ZERO).toFixed(3);
      get("[data-omega-minus]").textContent =
        (values.omegaMinus / OMEGA_ZERO).toFixed(3);
      get("[data-pmax]").textContent =
        values.mixingAmplitude.toFixed(3);
      get("[data-fill-one]").style.width =
        (100 * probabilityOne).toFixed(2) + "%";
      get("[data-fill-two]").style.width =
        (100 * probabilityTwo).toFixed(2) + "%";
      get("[data-prob-one]").textContent = probabilityOne.toFixed(3);
      get("[data-prob-two]").textContent = probabilityTwo.toFixed(3);
    }

    sourceButtons.forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        source = Number(button.dataset.source);
        sourceButtons.forEach(candidate => {
          candidate.setAttribute(
            "aria-pressed",
            candidate === button ? "true" : "false"
          );
        });
        beatPhase = 0;
        render();
      });
    });

    [massInput, couplingInput, initialInput, carrierInput, speedInput]
      .forEach(input => input.addEventListener("input", render));

    phaseInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
      beatPhase = Number(phaseInput.value) * Math.PI;
      render();
    });

    toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      running = !running;
      toggle.textContent = running ? "Пауза" : "Продолжить";
      lastFrame = performance.now();
    });

    reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
      beatPhase = 0;
      running = true;
      toggle.textContent = "Пауза";
      lastFrame = performance.now();
      render();
    });

    function animate(now) {
      if (!document.body.contains(root)) return;
      const elapsed = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastFrame) / 1000);
      lastFrame = now;
      const slide = root.closest("section");
      const active = !slide || slide.classList.contains("present");
      if (running && active) {
        const speed = Number(speedInput.value);
        beatPhase =
          (beatPhase + elapsed * speed * 0.72) % (2 * Math.PI);
        render();
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  function initializeAll() {
    document
      .querySelectorAll("[data-coupled-pendula-lab]")
      .forEach(initialize);
  }

  initializeAll();
  document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    initializeAll,
    {once: true}
  );
})();
</script>
```
